description:
Gnosis Chain on-chain read: the native balance of an address. Native xDAI balance of one address on Gnosis Chain at the latest block: the raw eth_getBalance result in wei (hex). Takes exactly one query parameter, address (0x + 40 hex).

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/gnosis_eth_getbalance. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
Measured output: {"chain": "gnosis", "hex": "0x78de861da3c39a15", "method": "eth_getBalance", "ok": true, "result": 8709546191240796693, "service": "x402_chain_reads_v1.gnosis_eth_getbalance"}
name: x402_chain_reads_v1__gnosis_eth_getbalance
